air quality and climate policy should consider the following: (1) the mix of greenhouse gases and air pollutants emitted, (2) the atmospheric lifetimes of these gases and particles, (3) the benefits of reducing air pollution and climate impacts, and (4) the trade-offs among the benefits of reducing greenhouse gas and air pollutant emissions.

air quality and climate policy can be more effective if the link between air and climate is considered in the policy process.
